introduce:
Sit upright. Place your hands behind your ears, with your elbows pointing outward.

Exhale, slowly rotate your upper body to the right as far as possible.

Inhale, switch sides and repeat. Breathe regularly throughout.
name: CHAIR TORSO TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please rotate your body gently and slowly.
Your toes and knees should always face forward.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
Breathe regularly throughout.
Please relax your shoulders.
This exercise stretches your back and hips.

introduce: Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upwards. Stretch your arms overhead.\n\nInhale, push your belly and chest forward and your chin up. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR BACKBEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This exercise stretches your upper body.

introduce: Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back.\n\nFold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.

introduce:
Sit with your legs wide apart and your toes pointing outward. Bring your hands on your knees.

Exhale, bend forward and twist your body to the left, bringing your left shoulder back and your right shoulder forward.

Inhale, return and repeat with the other side.
name: CHAIR REVOLVED GODDESS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Keep your breathing soft and deep.
Make sure your knees are aligned with your ankles.

introduce:
Sit with your legs a little wider than hip-width apart.

Release your legs and windshield wiper your legs from side to side.

Breathe rhythmically throughout the exercise.
name: CHAIR WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise warms up your hips and knees.
